content: Landed in 26cd0404 (ApplyPspAddressSpaces.java). Creates SMN+X86 overlay spaces, registers SMN_Pointer/X86_Pointer typedefs, rebinds existing plain typedefs into PointerTypedefs. Validated on Ryzen_Zen2_ver_0d15 (X86PADDR, 4 listing instances preserved) and Ryzen_Zen2_ver_0d1a (X86PADDR + SMNADDR, 6 + 0 instances). Idempotent on re-run.
